newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-MICHAEL BRADLEY WINS SHORTENED BUICK CHALLENGE IN PLAYOFF.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MICHAEL BRADLEY WINS SHORTENED BUICK CHALLENGE IN PLAYOFF.

text.p: Michael Bradley sank a 10-foot birdie putt at the first extra hole to win the rain-shortened $1 million Buick Challenge Sunday.
Bradley triumphed in a five-way playoff after officials cut the event to just 36 holes due to persistent heavy rain which saturated the Callaway Gardens course over the weekend.
"I'm elated. Hopefully this will lead to bigger and better things," said Bradley, who finished at 10-under-par 134 after rounds of 66 and 68.
He collected $180,000 for his first PGA Tour victory, and jumped to 18th on this year's money list.

The playoff was held at the saturated par-four 18th, where fellow Americans Fred Funk, John Maginnes, Davis Love and Len Mattiace missed their birdie tries before Bradley rolled his into the middle of the cup to become the 11th first-time winner on tour this year.
"I was nervous," he admitted. "My hands were shaking. I don't know how I ended up reading the putt right. Somehow it went right into the middle of the hole."
Earlier, officials scrapped the third round, even though 17 players had completed it before play was suspended at noon in heavy rain.
Play was scheduled to resume at 4 p.m., but when the course was deemed unplayable for the rest of the day, the round was cancelled and the tournament reverted to a 36-hole event.
The biggest loser was Jay Haas, who had picked up seven shots in 15 holes to go nine under before play was halted.
"I feel pretty disappointed," said Haas, who nonetheless acknowledged that officials had little choice but to scrub the round.
"It's unfortunate that it's me that's playing so well. It's just tough luck. I'll forget about it -- not on the drive home though."
It is the third time in five years this event has been shortened. In 1992 and 1994 it was cut to 54 holes.
It is also the third time in four weeks a PGA Tour event has been reduced. The Canadian and B.C. Opens were shortened to 54 holes.
